summary: Vasily Seseman was a philosopher who studied at Saint Petersburg State University from 1903 to 1909. He held posts at Saint Petersburg State University (~1919-1921), Vytautas Magnus University (~1923-1940), and Vilnius University (~1940-1960).

Vasudev Vishnu Gokhale was a scholar of Buddhist studies, Indology, and philosophy who completed his PhD at the University of Bonn in 1930. He held posts at Fergusson College, Visva-Bharati University, and the University of Delhi (Prof., 1959).

Vasudev Vishnu Mirashi was an Indologist and historian who earned degrees at Deccan College and the University of Mumbai. He served as Principal at Morris College and Government Vidarbha Institute, and was Hon. Professor at Nagpur University (1957-1966).

Vasudeva Sharan Agrawala was an Indologist and archaeologist who earned degrees from Banaras Hindu University and the University of Lucknow. He held posts at the Government Museum, Mathura (1931), the State Museum, Lucknow (1940), and the Archaeological Survey of India (1946).

Vasudha Dalmia is an Indologist and historian who studied at Miranda House, the University of Cologne, JNU (PhD 1984), and Heidelberg University. Her career included posts at the University of Tübingen, UC Berkeley (2001-2012), and Yale University (2013-2014).

Vasudha Narayanan is a scholar of religious studies and Indology who studied at the universities of Madras and Mumbai, as well as Harvard University. She served as Professor and Distinguished Professor of Religion at the University of Florida.
Vasumati Karandikar is an Indologist and philosopher who studied at the University of Mumbai (M.A. 2017-2019, 2022-2024) and earned a PhD at Kavikulaguru Kalidas Sanskrit University in 2021.

Vatroslav Jagić was a linguist who studied at Vienna under Franz Miklosich, Leipzig under August Leskien (PhD ~1870-1871), and under Albrecht Weber. He held professorships at Odesa University (1871-1874), Humboldt University (1874-1880), Saint Petersburg (1880-1886), and Vienna (1886-1909).

Vedprakash Sharma is a scholar of Indology who studied at the University of Delhi (1980-1985) and Maharshi Dayanand University (PhD 2005-2008). He served as a Research Associate at the University of Delhi.

Veeranarayana N. K. Pandurangi is a scholar of Indology, philosophy, and computational studies who earned doctorates at Central Sanskrit University and National Sanskrit University. He held positions at Poornaprajna Vidyapeetha, the French Institute of Pondicherry, JRRSU, and Karnataka Samskrit University.

Velcheru Narayana Rao is an Indologist who earned his MA and PhD at Andhra University. He held posts at the University of Wisconsin-Madison starting in 1971, and later served as a visiting professor at Chicago and Emory.

Velizar Sadovski is an Iranian, Central Asian, Indology, and linguistics scholar who earned his PhD at the University of Vienna (1996-2001). He held positions at the Austrian Academy of Sciences (from 1998) and the University of Vienna (from 2001).

Vempati Kutumba Sastry is a scholar of Indology and philosophy. He served as Vice-Chancellor of Central Sanskrit University (2003-2008) and as president of the International Association of Sanskrit Studies (~2006-2018).

Ven. Dhammapāla is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at the Postgraduate Institute of Pali and Buddhist Studies and earned a PhD from the University of Hong Kong under doctoral supervisor K. L. Dhammajoti.

Venoth Nallisamy is an Indology scholar who studied at Universiti Malaysia Sabah, Open University Malaysia, and the University of Malaya, where he received a PhD. He was appointed Senior Lecturer at INTI International University in 2024.

Vera Aleksandrovna Novikova was an Indologist and linguist who studied at Saint Petersburg State University (~1935-1940) under A. S. Zimin and A. P. Barannikov. She held posts at the Institute of Oriental Manuscripts (1949-1950) and Saint Petersburg State University (1952).

Verity Harte is a philosopher who studied at the University of Cambridge (~1987-1994). She held posts at St Edmund's College, St Hilda's College, King's College London (~1997-2005), and Yale University, where she was appointed Professor of Philosophy and Classics in 2006.

Verrier Elwin was a scholar of Indology and history/archaeology who studied at Merton College from 1921. He served as Deputy-Director of the Anthropological Survey of India (1946-1949) and Adviser for Tribal Affairs for the North-East Frontier Agency (1954).

Vesna Wallace is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology who studied at UC Berkeley. She held the Numata Chair in Buddhist Studies at Oxford (until 2010) and has been a professor at UC Santa Barbara.

Vicente Fatone was a scholar of philosophy, Indology, and Buddhist studies who studied at the University of Calcutta (1937-1938). He held professorships at the National University of the Litoral (1929), the National University of La Plata (1940), and Buenos Aires (1960).
